adjudication.depicted_input: The leftmost column of Figure 2c labeled "Input (DAPI)", showing the DAPI nuclear-staining image patches used as the conditioning image for TissueCraftAI's DAPI-to-H&E route.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is too broad because it is mainly a qualitative output-comparison grid. But the same full figure contains a defensible input-only region: the leftmost "Input (DAPI)" column in panel c. Under the atlas rules, a crop is valid when it visibly shows the route-specific input object, and a panel containing both input and output may be cropped to the input portion if the input is clearly identifiable. This supports the DAPI-to-H&E conditioning-image route only. It does not support the H&E-based proteomics or transcriptomics routes, which require an H&E input depiction from another figure.
